# Pendahuluan

Dokumen ini adalah notebook R Markdown berjudul "Trade-off Analysis (TA) Ekonomi Regional".

Mode: `r params$mode`
Jumlah skenario intervensi: `r params$n_scenarios`
Nama skenario intervensi: `r params$scenario_name`

Mode BAU: Proyeksi baseline tanpa intervensi.
Mode Scenario: Proyeksi BAU + Skenario `r params$scenario_name`

## Daftar Isi

1. [Proyeksi PDRB](#proyeksi-pdrb)
2. [Proyeksi Serapan Tenaga Kerja](#proyeksi-serapan-tenaga-kerja)
3. [Proyeksi Pendapatan Tenaga Kerja](#proyeksi-pendapatan-tenaga-kerja)
4. [Proyeksi Surplus Usaha Bruto](#proyeksi-surplus-usaha-bruto)
5. [Keterkaitan antar Sektor Lahan](#keterkaitan-antar-sektor-lahan)

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# INPUT & PREPROCESSING
# =====================================================

descriptive_analysis_file <- "inst/extdata/output/descriptive_analysis_module.rds"
projection_area_file_bau <- "inst/extdata/example_data/Bukecap/luc_projection_bukecap_bau.xlsx"
# =====================================================
# Input: PADAGIMO (uncomment line di bawah ini jika yang dijalankan PADGIMO)
# projection_area_file_bau <- "inst/extdata/example_data/Padagimo/luc_projection_padagimo_bau.xlsx"
# =====================================================
initial_year <- params$initial_year

baseline <- load_projection_baseline(
  path = descriptive_analysis_file,
  projection_area_file_bau = projection_area_file_bau
)

# Akses komponen baseline
gdp_baseline      <- baseline$gdp_baseline
leontief_matrix   <- baseline$leontief_matrix
full_io_table     <- baseline$full_io_table
code_registry     <- baseline$code_registry
sector_idx        <- baseline$sector_idx
income_multiplier <- baseline$income_multiplier
labour_multiplier <- baseline$labour_multiplier
SUB_multiplier    <- baseline$SUB_multiplier
output_multiplier <- baseline$output_multiplier
linkage_table     <- baseline$linkage_table
P_default         <- baseline$P_default
growth_rate       <- baseline$growth_rate
area_matrix_bau   <- baseline$area_matrix_bau
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# VALIDASI JUMLAH SKENARIO
# =====================================================
if (params$mode == "Scenario" && params$n_scenarios != 1) {
  stop("Saat ini modul proyeksi hanya mendukung 1 skenario intervensi. ",
       "Silakan set params$n_scenarios = 1.")
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# PROYEKSI BAU
# =====================================================
message("Menjalankan proyeksi BAU...")

projection_bau <- run_projection(
  gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
  income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
  labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
  SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
  output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
  linkage_table       = linkage_table,
  leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
  full_io_table       = full_io_table,
  sector_idx          = sector_idx,
  P                   = P_default,
  area_matrix         = area_matrix_bau,
  growth_rate         = growth_rate,
  lpc_scenario        = NULL,
  io_changes          = NULL,
  intensity_table     = NULL
)
projection_bau$SCENARIO <- "BAU"

all_projections <- list(BAU = projection_bau)
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# PROYEKSI SKENARIO INTERVENSI
# =====================================================
if (params$mode == "Scenario") {
  message("Menjalankan proyeksi skenario intervensi...")

  scenario_inputs <- list(
    name = paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name),
    luc_projection    = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/luc_projection.xlsx",
    land_distribution = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/distribusi_lahan.xlsx",
    growth_rate       = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/growth_rate.xlsx",
    lpc               = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/produktivitas_lpc.xlsx",
    io_changes        = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/perubahan_io.xlsx",
    intensity         = "inst/extdata/scenario/scenario1/intensitas.xlsx"
  )
  
  # =====================================================
  # Input: PADAGIMO (uncomment line di bawah ini jika yang dijalankan PADGIMO)
  # =====================================================
  # scenario_inputs <- list(
  #   name = paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name),
  #   luc_projection    = "inst/extdata/scenario/Padagimo/scenario1/luc_projection.xlsx",
  #   land_distribution = "inst/extdata/scenario/Padagimo/scenario1/distribusi_lahan.xlsx",
  #   growth_rate       = "inst/extdata/scenario/Padagimo/scenario1/growth_rate.xlsx",
  #   lpc               = "inst/extdata/scenario/Padagimo/scenario1/produktivitas_lpc.xlsx",
  #   io_changes        = "inst/extdata/scenario/Padagimo/scenario1/perubahan_io.xlsx",
  #   intensity         = "inst/extdata/scenario/Padagimo/scenario1/intensitas.xlsx"
  # )


  sc_input <- load_scenario_inputs(scenario_inputs, P_default, growth_rate)

  # Area matrix untuk skenario
  projection_area_sc <- read_input_file(sc_input$luc_projection, header = TRUE)
  projection_long_sc <- projection_area_sc |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -c(ID, LC), names_to = "YEAR", values_to = "AREA") |>
    dplyr::mutate(YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR))
  area_matrix_sc <- create_area_matrix(projection_long_sc)

  projection_sc <- run_projection(
    gdp_baseline        = gdp_baseline,
    income_multiplier   = income_multiplier,
    labour_multiplier   = labour_multiplier,
    SUB_multiplier      = SUB_multiplier,
    output_multiplier   = output_multiplier,
    linkage_table       = linkage_table,
    leontief_matrix     = leontief_matrix,
    full_io_table       = full_io_table,
    sector_idx          = sector_idx,
    P                   = sc_input$P,
    area_matrix         = area_matrix_sc,
    growth_rate         = sc_input$growth_rate,
    lpc_scenario        = sc_input$lpc_scenario,
    io_changes          = sc_input$io_changes,
    intensity_table     = sc_input$intensity_table
  )

  projection_sc$SCENARIO <- paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name)

  all_projections[[paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name)]] <- projection_sc
  
    # Simpan hasil skenario
  scenario_inputs_for_save <- list(
    gdp_baseline      = gdp_baseline,
    leontief_matrix   = leontief_matrix,
    full_io_table     = full_io_table,
    code_registry     = code_registry,
    sector_idx        = sector_idx,
    income_multiplier = income_multiplier,
    labour_multiplier = labour_multiplier,
    SUB_multiplier    = SUB_multiplier,
    output_multiplier = output_multiplier,
    linkage_table     = linkage_table,
    P                 = sc_input$P,
    growth_rate       = sc_input$growth_rate,
    lpc_scenario      = sc_input$lpc_scenario,
    io_changes        = sc_input$io_changes,
    intensity_table   = sc_input$intensity_table
  )

  save_projection_results(
    paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name),
    result = projection_sc,
    area_matrix = area_matrix_sc,
    inputs = scenario_inputs_for_save,
    output_dir = "inst/extdata/output"
  )
}
```

```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Gabungkan hasil proyeksi
projection_combined <- dplyr::bind_rows(all_projections)
rownames(projection_combined) <- NULL

message("Selesai. Total skenario: ", length(all_projections))
```

# Hasil Proyeksi — Mode: `r params$mode`
Jumlah skenario: `r length(all_projections)`
Skenario yang dibandingkan: `r paste(names(all_projections), collapse = " vs ")`

## Proyeksi PDRB (IDR/Tahun)
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
gdp_comparison <- projection_combined |>
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR, SCENARIO) |>
  dplyr::summarise(GDP = sum(GDP), .groups = "drop")

gdp_base <- tibble::tibble(
  YEAR = initial_year,
  SCENARIO = unique(gdp_comparison$SCENARIO),
  GDP = rep(sum(gdp_baseline$GDP), length(unique(gdp_comparison$SCENARIO)))
)

gdp_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(gdp_base, gdp_comparison) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SCENARIO, YEAR)

gdp_wide <- create_comparison_table(gdp_comparison, "GDP")

DT::datatable(gdp_wide, rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Perbandingan PDRB per Skenario (IDR/Tahun)") %>%
  DT::formatRound(columns = 2:ncol(gdp_wide), digits = 2, mark = ",")

plot_comparison(gdp_comparison, "GDP", "Perbandingan Proyeksi PDRB", "IDR/Tahun")
```

## Keterkaitan antar Sektor Lahan antar Skenario per Tahun
```{r, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ITFL
itfl_comparison <- projection_combined |>
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR, SCENARIO) |>
  dplyr::summarise(ITFL = mean(ITFL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

itfl_base <- tibble::tibble(
  YEAR = initial_year,
  SCENARIO = unique(itfl_comparison$SCENARIO),
  ITFL = rep(mean(linkage_table$ITFL, na.rm = TRUE), length(unique(itfl_comparison$SCENARIO)))
)

itfl_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(itfl_base, itfl_comparison) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SCENARIO, YEAR)

itfl_wide <- create_comparison_table(itfl_comparison, "ITFL")

DT::datatable(itfl_wide, rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Perbandingan Forward Linkage (ITFL) per Skenario") %>%
  DT::formatRound(columns = 2:ncol(itfl_wide), digits = 2)

plot_comparison(itfl_comparison, "ITFL", "Perbandingan Keterkaitan ke Depan (ITFL)", "Indeks")

# ITBL
itbl_comparison <- projection_combined |>
  dplyr::group_by(YEAR, SCENARIO) |>
  dplyr::summarise(ITBL = mean(ITBL, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

itbl_base <- tibble::tibble(
  YEAR = initial_year,
  SCENARIO = unique(itbl_comparison$SCENARIO),
  ITBL = rep(mean(linkage_table$ITBL, na.rm = TRUE), length(unique(itbl_comparison$SCENARIO)))
)

itbl_comparison <- dplyr::bind_rows(itbl_base, itbl_comparison) |>
  dplyr::arrange(SCENARIO, YEAR)

itbl_wide <- create_comparison_table(itbl_comparison, "ITBL")

DT::datatable(itbl_wide, rownames = FALSE,
  caption = "Perbandingan Backward Linkage (ITBL) per Skenario") %>%
  DT::formatRound(columns = 2:ncol(itbl_wide), digits = 2)

plot_comparison(itbl_comparison, "ITBL", "Perbandingan Keterkaitan ke Belakang (ITBL)", "Indeks")
```

```{r save-bau-rds, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# =====================================================
# SAVE BAU RESULTS TO RDS
# =====================================================

dir.create("inst/extdata/output", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Build a list containing BAU projection results
bau_results <- list(
  scenario    = "BAU",
  result      = projection_bau,
  area_matrix = area_matrix_bau,
  inputs = list(
    gdp_baseline      = gdp_baseline,
    leontief_matrix   = leontief_matrix,
    full_io_table     = full_io_table,
    code_registry     = code_registry,
    sector_idx        = sector_idx,
    income_multiplier = income_multiplier,
    labour_multiplier = labour_multiplier,
    SUB_multiplier    = SUB_multiplier,
    output_multiplier = output_multiplier,
    linkage_table     = linkage_table,
    P_default         = P_default,
    growth_rate       = growth_rate,
    lpc_scenario      = NULL,
    io_changes        = NULL,
    intensity_table   = NULL
  )
)

saveRDS(bau_results, "inst/extdata/output/projection_bau.rds")
message("BAU results saved to: inst/extdata/output/projection_bau.rds")
```

```{r save-scenario-rds, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=params$mode=="Scenario"}
# =====================================================
# SAVE SCENARIO RESULTS TO RDS
# =====================================================

dir.create("inst/extdata/output", showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Use the scenario name from params
scenario_label <- paste0("Skenario_", params$scenario_name)

# Build a list containing scenario projection results
scenario_results <- list(
  scenario    = scenario_label,
  result      = projection_sc,
  area_matrix = area_matrix_sc,
  inputs = list(
    gdp_baseline      = gdp_baseline,
    leontief_matrix   = leontief_matrix,
    full_io_table     = full_io_table,
    code_registry     = code_registry,
    sector_idx        = sector_idx,
    income_multiplier = income_multiplier,
    labour_multiplier = labour_multiplier,
    SUB_multiplier    = SUB_multiplier,
    output_multiplier = output_multiplier,
    linkage_table     = linkage_table,
    P                 = sc_input$P,
    growth_rate       = sc_input$growth_rate,
    lpc_scenario      = sc_input$lpc_scenario,
    io_changes        = sc_input$io_changes,
    intensity_table   = sc_input$intensity_table
  )
)

# Sanitize filename (replace spaces and special characters)
file_name <- paste0("projection_", gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", scenario_label), ".rds")

saveRDS(scenario_results, file.path("inst/extdata/output", file_name))
message("Scenario results saved to: inst/extdata/output/", file_name)
```
